混沌的噪音凝聚为压抑的黑暗。我们感觉自己的意图在被仔细审视、研究、评判。

texts.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

Chaotic noise yields to an oppressive darkness. We feel our intentions scrutinized, studied, judged.

The heavy expectation of order, unchallenged and immutable, peers deep within us. The Unyielding One judges our intent.

Its gaze having passed over us, the darkness recedes. The infectious scrutiny compels us to fall in line.

texts.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为不屈之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Unyielding One.

texts.zh:
我们跪伏在不屈之物前。

我们的心智被毫不妥协的权威以冷漠的态度审视着，一边审判着我们，一边将我们固定在原地。

空置之御座高压的真空没有一丝仁慈——但也没有痛苦。祂只寻求秩序和确定性，并将其施加到一切缺乏之处。

我们现在将这份重担承在了身上。
texts.en:
We have knelt in the presence of the Unyielding One.

Our minds were scrutinized with the cold indifference of uncompromising authority, fixing us in place as we were judged.

The oppressive vacuum of the Vacant Throne offers no mercy - nor suffering. It expects only order and certainty, imposing it where it is found lacking.

We now carry this weight with us.

summary.text:
# 空置之御座 / Vacant Throne

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt` · `events/shroud_events.txt` · `common/inline_scripts/shroud/minor_patron_first_contact_end_event.txt` · `common/patrons/patron_types.txt`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 次要赞助者“空置之御座”的首次接触事件“虚境中的低语”（shroud.4110），由代码在虚境中自然发现时触发（common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1543），或经“虚境触及者”选项触发（须已接触全部主要赞助者）。  
  First-contact event "Whispers in the Shroud" (shroud.4110) of the minor patron "Vacant Throne", launched by the game on natural discovery in the Shroud (common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1543) or by the Shroud-touched option (all major patrons must be contacted first).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- shroud.4110：单一选项“尝试沟通”按帝国类型启用机械版/蜂巢版/基础版接触项目（events/shroud_events.txt:8876，inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start_event）。  
  shroud.4110: the single option enables the robot / hive / base contact project by empire type (events/shroud_events.txt:8876, inline script minor_patron_first_contact_start_event).
- 项目成本5000（社会科技），无时限，完成后触发shroud.4115。  
  The project costs 5000 (society technology), has no time limit and fires shroud.4115 on completion.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- shroud.4115仅一个选项，把接触状态记为completed。  
  shroud.4115 has a single option that sets the first-contact state to completed.
- 三个项目版本互斥，仅由帝国类型决定。  
  The three project versions are mutually exclusive and depend only on empire type.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无其他差异。  
  No other variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt、events/shroud_events.txt与inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event。  
  Compared %s, %s and the minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event inline scripts.
- 合并：原有的_HIVE与_ROBOT故事是同一接触项目的帝国类型版本，现并入本故事。  
  Merged: the former _HIVE and _ROBOT stories are the empire-type versions of the same contact project and are now part of this one story.
- 以起始事件为根并添加审阅连接。 项目标题使用游戏内的“未接触前代号”（如“Fathomless Being”），本故事标题使用赞助者名称。  
  The start event is the root, with reviewed bridges. Project titles use the in-game pre-contact code names (e.g. Fathomless Being); the story title uses the patron name.
- 覆盖 Coverage：全部5个文档（含机械/蜂巢版项目）。 / All 5 docs (including robot/hive project versions).
